name: SeDMA
summary: SeDMA is a bioisosteric analogue of 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-methylamphetamine (MDMA) which was developed in an attempt to create an improved MDMA alternative for potential clinical use. It is the analogue of MDMA in which the 1,3-benzodioxole ring has been replaced with a 2,1,3-benzoselenadiazole ring. ODMA and TDMA are closely related analogues.

pharmacology.text: ODMA, TDMA, and SeDMA are releasing agents of serotonin, norepinephrine, and dopamine similarly to MDMA. MDMA and 3,4-methylenedioxyamphetamine (MDA) are well-known serotonergic neurotoxins that damage serotonergic neurons in the brain.

uses.en: It is a research compound with no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Entactogens of this family can cause jaw clenching, a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, dangerous overheating, low mood in the days after use, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這一類同感藥可能引起咬牙、心跳加快、血壓升高、危險的體溫過高、使用後幾天情緒低落，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这一类同感药可能引起咬牙、心跳加快、血压升高、危险的体温过高、使用后几天情绪低落，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: SeDMA is MDMA with the two ring oxygens replaced by selenium, an element below sulfur in the periodic table. It is one of a trio with ODMA and TDMA, which use oxygen and sulfur.
fact.zh: SeDMA 是把 MDMA 環上的兩個氧原子換成硒，硒在元素週期表上位於硫的下方。它和使用氧與硫的 ODMA 及 TDMA 構成一組三個化合物。
fact.zhHans: SeDMA 是把 MDMA 环上的两个氧原子换成硒，硒在元素周期表上位于硫的下方。它和使用氧与硫的 ODMA 及 TDMA 构成一组三个化合物。
